build_head_meaning: GitHub workflow head_sha (reviewed PR head); checkout uses PR merge ref
limits: Browser regressions cover Chromium and Firefox on the five existing hosts only; they make no Alpine browser support claim.
Pinned Vitest 5.0.0 and Playwright 1.63.0 were tested; the separate latest-vitest job was skipped.

GitHub run, artifact, and job head identities equal the reviewed PR head; the checkout action builds the GitHub PR merge ref. A sampled job checkout log records merge commit 6c2e27796c094e2ac50fe5e2665cd39c55cb7bc1; GitHub commit API confirms its source tree exactly matches the reviewed head. Browser result artifacts retain CLI version but no CLI binary hash or commit identity.
Cleanup verification reads retained process observations, temporary entry names, and cleanup-error fields; this verifier cannot inspect file types or contents on the completed hosted runner.
Successful proof receipts corroborate the source scratch-empty assertion; no independent scratch-directory listing was retained.

The proof browser-file predicate checks names starting with playwright only. Zero matching entries does not prove absence of every browser-related file. All remaining temporary names are preserved per artifact, including mozilla-temp-files on Windows Firefox; their types, contents, and cause were not independently established.
Firefox page-crash proves handling a page lost mid-test rather than a Chromium DevTools renderer crash.
